questions.question_text:
Read the following passage carefully: 'The dense Amazon rainforest is home to thousands of unique species. Among them is the poison dart frog, a tiny but brightly colored amphibian. Its brilliant colors, ranging from neon blue to bright yellow, act as a warning to predators that it is highly toxic. Unlike most frogs that camouflage to hide, this frog wants to be seen.' 
Why does the poison dart frog have bright, neon colors instead of camouflaging like other frogs?
options: A) To attract insects for food
B) To warn predators that it is highly toxic and dangerous to eat
C) To hide effectively among colorful jungle flowers
D) Because it absorbs too much bright sunlight
questions.answer: B) To warn predators that it is highly toxic and dangerous to eat

questions.question_text: Based on the passage, the word 'camouflage' most nearly means:
options: B) To jump from tree to tree
C) To blend in and hide with the surrounding environment
D) To make a loud croaking sound
questions.answer: C) To blend in and hide with the surrounding environment

questions.question_text: Which class of animals does the poison dart frog belong to, according to the text?
questions.answer: C) Amphibian

questions.question_text: In your own words, describe the main survival strategy of the poison dart frog as mentioned in the passage. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The poison dart frog survives by using its bright neon colors as a natural warning signal, which scares away predators by telling them it is poisonous to eat.

questions.question_text: How does the poison dart frog's behavior differ from the typical behavior of most other frogs? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: While most normal frogs use natural camouflage to hide from predators, the poison dart frog actively wants to be seen to warn predators of its toxicity.

questions.question_text: If a predator ignored the frog's bright colors, what would likely happen, based on your understanding of the text? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: If a predator ignored the bright warning colors and tried to eat the frog, it would likely be poisoned or become very sick due to the frog's high toxicity.

sections.section_name: Section B - Writing Skills & Applied Grammar

questions.question_text: Identify the subject and predicate in the following sentence: 'The old wooden bridge over the river collapsed during the heavy storm.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The subject is 'The old wooden bridge over the river' and the predicate is 'collapsed during the heavy storm.'

questions.question_text: Choose the correct abstract noun to fill in the blank: The brave soldier was awarded a medal for his outstanding ________.
questions.answer: C) bravery

questions.question_text: Change the following sentence into the Simple Past Tense: 'The children fly colorful kites in the park every Sunday.'
options: A) The children will fly colorful kites in the park.
B) The children flew colorful kites in the park.
C) The children are flying colorful kites in the park.
D) The children had flown colorful kites in the park.
questions.answer: B) The children flew colorful kites in the park.

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the adjective: Mount Everest is the ________ mountain peak in the world.
questions.answer: C) highest

questions.question_text: Select the correct pronoun to complete the sentence: Rohan and Amit finished ________ homework before going out to play.
questions.answer: B) their

questions.question_text: Identify the type of sentence: 'Please close the door quietly when you leave the room.'
questions.answer: C) Imperative

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank with the appropriate article: I saw ________ eagle flying high up in the clear blue sky.
questions.answer: B) an

questions.question_text: Choose the correct main verb to complete the sentence: The hungry dog ________ the bone quickly before anyone could take it.
questions.answer: C) ate

questions.question_text: Write a short paragraph describing your favorite hobby and why it brings you joy. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: My favorite hobby is reading adventure books. Whenever I open a book, I feel like I am traveling to magical lands and meeting brave heroes. Reading not only improves my vocabulary but also helps me relax after a long day at school. It brings me immense joy and sparks my imagination.

questions.question_text: Write a formal application to your school Principal requesting a three-day leave to attend your sister's wedding in another city. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: To, The Principal, St. Xavier's School. Subject: Leave application for three days. Respected Sir/Madam, I am a student of Class 6. I humbly request you to grant me leave for three days, from 15th to 17th November, as I have to travel out of the city to attend my elder sister's wedding. Thanking you. Yours obediently, Rahul Sharma.

questions.question_text: Read the extract: 'He worked from dawn to dusk, clearing the weeds, planting the saplings, and watering them carefully, all while keeping his eyes peeled for the magical drops.' Who is the 'he' referred to in this line from 'A Bottle of Dew'?
questions.answer: C) Rama Nathan

questions.question_text: In the poem 'What a Bird Thought', what did the bird initially think the whole world was made of?
questions.answer: B) Pale blue shells

questions.question_text: Why did the fox praise the raven's voice in the story 'The Raven and the Fox'? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The cunning fox praised the raven's voice entirely to trick it. He knew that if the flattered raven opened its beak to sing, the piece of cheese it was holding would fall straight into his mouth.

questions.question_text: In 'The Unlikely Best Friends', how did the two very different animals help each other survive the harsh winter? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The blind animal used its keen sense of hearing to detect danger, while the lame animal sat on its back and used its sharp eyesight to guide them safely towards food and shelter during the winter.

questions.question_text: Describe the main message conveyed in the poem 'A Friend's Prayer'. What does the speaker ask for? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The speaker prays not for wealth or fame, but for the strength to be a loyal, supportive, and understanding friend in times of trouble, emphasizing that true friendship is the greatest blessing in life.

questions.question_text: According to the chapter 'Neem Baba', list two medicinal or practical uses of the Neem tree that make it so valuable to villagers. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The Neem tree is highly valuable because its bitter leaves are used to cure skin diseases and keep insects away from stored grains, while its twigs are traditionally used as natural toothbrushes to maintain dental hygiene.

questions.question_text: In 'Rama to the Rescue', explain in detail how Rama used his quick thinking and intelligence to save the villagers from the dangerous situation, rather than relying on physical strength. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: When the wild elephant entered the village, everyone panicked. Rama did not try to fight the beast with weapons. Instead, using his sharp presence of mind, he quickly gathered dry chillies and lit a smoky fire upwind. The irritating, pungent smoke confused and drove the elephant away back into the forest, saving the village without any bloodshed.

questions.question_text: Analyze the ending of 'A Bottle of Dew'. How does the sage's trick transform Rama Nathan's life permanently? What moral lesson does this teach us? [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The sage tricked Rama Nathan into cultivating a massive banana plantation by telling him it was the only way to collect magical dew. Though there was no magic potion, selling the bananas made him incredibly wealthy. The transformation taught him that there are no shortcuts to success; hard work, patience, and dedication are the true magic that brings prosperity.
